# Bounded parity snapshot discovery optimization

Base a71e58e4e1e080c74644fbf5bcf07ac825696fbd. Owner: existing GPK-V0-002/005 verification obligations, ROADMAP verification-cost backlog; no AT ticket closure.

Problem: the last canonical cli-parity package consumed408.224s. Every before/after snapshot separately launches sanitized bounded Git for absolute git-dir and common-dir. A combined rev-parse can remove one discovery launch per ordinary snapshot, without changing fixture materialization, cache behavior, workers or process policy. Benefit unmeasured.

Owned implementation: conformance/cli-parity-v0/snapshot.go plus focused snapshot tests. Docs: README implementation note, owning GPK spec implementation evidence (no requirement change), spec index only if required, BUILD-LOG measured outcome and matching optimization backlog. No manifest, corpus, normalization, oracle, native CLI, model, prompt, cache or scheduler changes.

Algorithm: run rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir through the existing sanitized bounded Git adapter. Accept only exactly two nonempty absolute paths after the existing per-value whitespace trimming semantics. If output is ambiguous (including newline paths), or the combined invocation fails, use the existing two calls and preserve their error precedence. Continue unchanged status call, whole-worktree/git/common snapshots, sorting, hashes and output. No output-derived path is trusted as authority beyond existing Git discovery; no snapshot exclusion changes. Cancellation must remain bounded, with no unowned child.

Acceptance criteria frozen before implementation:
A1 Exact full repositorySnapshot equality versus the old two-call implementation on ordinary SHA1/SHA256, linked, dirty/untracked, symlink, nonASCII/spaces, newline-parent fixtures. Errors preserve old failure behavior; malformed combined output never becomes successful incomplete discovery.
A2 Ordinary snapshots use one discovery subprocess rather than two; ambiguous/failing combined lookup falls back and preserves all source/git/common observations. Real fixtures and narrow fake-executable invocation logging independently discriminate paths/counts, no test only reasserts implementation constants.
A3 Every corpus case still uses all three fresh sequential executions and before/after snapshots; full baseline and candidate replay use the same unchanged installed subject binary and manifest and produce byte-identical ordered transcript, including known divergences, identity and NOT_RUN cells.
A4 Existing owned-process supervision/cancellation semantics remain intact; focused interruption/fallback fixtures prove no lingering child. No new daemon/server or escaping child profile.
A5 Real next-use: changed runner verifies this slice in the canonical gate; no roadmap promotion or complete-task/token savings claim.

Verification: record the old runner binary before implementation and full baseline replay under the qualified supervisor. An independent reviewer checks this plan, then source/test evidence after build. Root retains an exact source copy of old snapshotRepository as a private differential/benchmark reference. Run fixed-size paired snapshot samples with all dimensions compared and preserve failures; run one full old/new replay under identical worker/GOMAXPROCS settings and same subject SHA. Wall results are engineering screen only, host/cache effects NOT_OBSERVED. Land only with exact correctness/parity, fewer launches, and measured snapshot improvement without a demonstrated full-replay regression; ambiguous timings remain inconclusive, never task-cost savings. Keep one canonical gate after final source freeze and final CEM/OCM dogfood workflow.

Time/work bound: one implementation/review repair slice; no recursive tools. If discovery combining is not safe/useful, preserve negative evidence and stop this candidate, continuing the existing loop later.

## Gate A resolution (frozen before implementation / candidate measurements)
Independent capture_review: no HIGH; two MED and two LOW addressed here.
- Performance screen: 12 old/new pairs per fixed fixture, alternating AB then BA, report each raw duration and median paired whole-snapshot relative change pooled over the fixed matrix; discovery-stage timing separately. Require at least5% median whole-snapshot improvement and exact equality for this bounded screen. One already-registered full baseline replay followed by one full candidate replay; candidate elapsed must be <=105% of baseline for a non-regression screen. If noisy or thresholds fail, label inconclusive/regressed and do not land for performance on these data; do not change N/threshold after observing candidate. No confidence interval, population or full-task cost claim.
- Timeout tradeoff consciously accepted for this experiment: combined lookup plus two legacy calls can spend at most90s of configured per-process timeout versus60s before (excluding bounded shutdown overhead), always capped earlier by caller cancellation/deadline. Ordinary path reduces work; ambiguity/failure may add one bounded call. Preserve this downside in docs/results. No new global timer or changes to shared process policy. Validate cancellation with a short caller deadline and dead-child assertion. Reject any unbounded continuation after context cancellation.
- Exact errors: fallback tests discriminate legacy git-dir error and legacy common-dir error text/order after ambiguous/failed combined lookup. They retain complete raw attempts. Successful malformed responses cannot be treated as full paths. Use line splitting plus per-value TrimSpace, never Fields/Scanner.
- Discovery launch-count assertions cover ordinary one-call success and full three-call fallback; a legacy first-call failure legitimately stops after the combined attempt plus first legacy attempt.

## Candidate repair after complete R1 screen
R1 preserved in candidate-r1.json and the original paired runs: all snapshot fields equal,31.4% pooled median improvement, but four newline-parent cells regressed31–33%. Avoid the already-known ambiguous case by directly using legacy discovery when git.dir contains LF. This does not claim a clean root rules out newline metadata elsewhere; output-discovered ambiguity still falls back. Real newline-root launch expectation becomes2; forced ambiguous combined output remains3. Rerun the entire same14-cell,12-pair matrix and separate stage screen for the changed candidate; keep thresholds, order, scorer and allR1 failures/observations. Full replay comparison remains pending, against the frozen original runner and unchanged subject. No mixed-revision summary or original-candidate full-replay claim.
